name.ja: ピカちんキット10 紙飛行機ランチャー

description.ja: • スピーディーにかっこよく紙飛行機をとばしたいキミへ！
description.en: • For you who want to fly paper airplanes quickly and coolly!

description.ja: • 長距離&超スピードで紙飛行機をとばせるスーパーランチャー！
description.en: • Super launcher that lets you fly paper airplanes over long distances and super speed!

description.ja: • テレビ番組「ポチっと発明 ピカちんキット」に登場する紙飛行機ランチャーが商品化！
description.en: • The paper airplane launcher that appears on the TV program "Pochitto Invention Pikachin Kit" has been commercialized!

description.ja: • 狙いを定めてバーを引っぱるだけで超スピードで紙飛行機をとばせちゃう発明品！
description.en: • An invention that allows you to fly a paper airplane at super speed just by aiming and pulling the bar!

description.ja: • ピカちん大百科に綴じられるピカちんシートも付いてくるぞ！
description.en: • It also comes with a Pikachin sheet that can be bound into the Pikachin Encyclopedia!
